title: netbox-mermaid plugin
description: Meta/visualization NetBox 4.6 plugin: introspects the whole SoT and renders it as one Mermaid flowchart (UI + source-string API), with a public-safe sanitize mode. No models, no hard deps — every in-house plugin is an OPTIONAL, apps.is_installed()-guarded collector. Baseline scaffold + full spec is committed and py_compile-clean; mermaid.min.js was vendored from jsdelivr (not stubbed). The items below are the deep work owed against a live NetBox.

phases.title: Live-NetBox verification
phases.exit_criteria: The full test suite is green and the UI renders the Mermaid diagram on the pinned NetBox 4.6.

items.description: `python /opt/netbox/app/netbox/manage.py test netbox_mermaid --keepdb -v2` green: test_builder (core Site/Device/VM graph → flowchart header, node ids/labels, subgraph nesting, escaping), test_sanitizer (no hostname/IP/secret leak, determinism, count preservation), test_api (GET diagram + ?sanitize=true → 200, non-empty mermaid, counts).

Confirm the vendored static/netbox_mermaid/mermaid.min.js draws the flowchart in the NetBox UI under the strict Content-Security-Policy (it exposes globalThis.mermaid), the scope selector + Sanitize toggle round-trip via GET, and the copy/toggle-source buttons work with no inline-script CSP violations.

Re-confirm the collector field names against each deployed sibling wheel (netbox-services/-database/-webserver/-wordpress/-pki/-email/-federation). A renamed field degrades to a skipped source (guarded import), not a crash, but the collector should track the current names so its data actually appears.

phases.title: Deploy
phases.exit_criteria: Plugin is installed as a wheel on prod + dev NetBox and the SoT Diagram page + API are reachable.

items.description: Build + `uv pip install --no-deps --reinstall` the wheel (with templates + static shipped via package-data) into the NetBox venv (prod pct 74234, dev pct 92254), add netbox_mermaid to PLUGINS, collectstatic, restart once. No migration (model-free). No ObjectPermission grant needed (no models); the API endpoint gates on IsAuthenticated.

phases.title: Extensions
phases.exit_criteria: Optional readability + coverage enhancements as the SoT grows.

items.description: Drop-in collectors for the remaining in-house plugins as they warrant visualization (e.g. netbox-ai inference deployments/GPUs, netbox-guests mounts) — one Collector subclass + one registry line each.
Wire node click-through to the underlying NetBox object detail page (raw_attrs already carry the identifying detail for tooltips; never emit them into the sanitized diagram).
